from typing import Final
REASON_A: Final = 'Each update reads the previous write'
REASON_B: str = 'Each update reads the previous write'
REASON_C: Final[str] = 'Each update reads the previous write'
SHORT: Final[str] = 'too short'
async def run(items, step):
    await in_order(items, step, reason=REASON_A)
    await in_order(items, step, reason=REASON_B)
    await in_order_steps([step], reason=REASON_C)
    # ruleid: in-order-needs-reason-python
    await in_order(items, step, reason=SHORT)
